1 .  Heard Mr. R. Islam, learned counsel for the petitioner and Ms. S.H. Bora, learned Addl. P.P. for State respondent.

2. The petitioner Kaziz Zaman @ Kazi Zaman has filed an application under Section 438 Page No.#
2/2 Cr.PC with prayer for pre-arrest bail as he is apprehending arrest in connection with Mankachar P.S. Case No. 1010/2021 under Sections 120(B)/493/376/365/34 IPC.

sentences.text: I have considered the submissions at the Bar.
The FIR unfolds that the petitioner had a relationship with the informant under the false promise of marriage.
On 27.11.2021 at about 7 PM the petitioner forcefully took her towards Barpeta promising to marry her.

Thereafter the other accused-persons named in the FIR called them to Jhowdanga to the house of an Advocate to solemnise their marriage but the informant was driven away from the Advocate's house and they restrained the petitioner who finally cheated the informant and did not marry her.
To consider the bail petition CD is necessary.

4. It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that the petitioner is a young lad of 20 years of age and the informant is 27 years old and she is a divorcee with two children who had a consensuous relationship with the petitioner.

5. Call for the CD along with the 164 Cr.PC statement of the victim.
6.

In the interim and in the event of his arrest, the petitioner shall be enlarged on bail of Rs.
50,000/- with a suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority.
